name: Solomon's Plea to Westfall
summary: Solomon's Plea to Westfall is an urgent written appeal penned by Magistrate Solomon of Lakeshire. Desperate for reinforcements against the Blackrock orcs and gnolls, Solomon sends this dispatch to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall hoping the newly formed People's Militia can lend aid while Stormwind's royal army fails to respond.

sections.title: A Desperate Call for Aid
sections.body: As the threat of the Blackrock clan and hostile gnolls looms large over Redridge, Magistrate Solomon finds himself dangerously isolated in Lakeshire. The royal army from Stormwind has inexplicably failed to arrive in force to defend the region's borders. Unable to wait for official support from the kingdom's capital, Solomon pens this plea in a desperate bid to recruit assistance from outside the regular military structure. Having caught word of a volunteer defense force coalescing across Elwynn to the west, he turns directly to the People's Militia.

sections.title: Reaching Across the Border
sections.body: The message is addressed directly to Gryan Stoutmantle, a veteran warrior organizing the frontier defense of Westfall. Solomon hopes Stoutmantle can spare fighters to reinforce Lakeshire until Stormwind's crown finally sends regular reserves. Entrusted to an adventurer acting as courier, the document reflects the fracturing administrative coordination across Stormwind's outlying territories, where local magistrates are left to negotiate mutual aid agreements on their own initiative.

faq.q: What is Solomon's Plea to Westfall?
faq.answer: It is an official written petition written by Magistrate Solomon of Lakeshire, asking Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia in Westfall to send military reinforcements to help defend Redridge.

faq.q: Why is Magistrate Solomon asking Westfall for help instead of Stormwind?
faq.answer: Solomon notes that something strange is happening with the Stormwind Army, as royal troops have failed to arrive in force despite Lakeshire's worsening peril. Lacking the time to wait on the Crown, Solomon turns to any nearby fighting force willing to help.

Gryan Stoutmantle is a decorated veteran of the Second War who leads the People's Militia, a grass-roots defensive league organized by local farmers and settlers to protect Westfall from the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: What threats are pushing Solomon to send this letter?
faq.answer: Lakeshire is facing aggressive incursions from the Blackrock orcs, alongside raiding gnolls throughout the Redridge Mountains, stretching the local town guard beyond its limits.

angles.text: The document highlights the mounting administrative paralysis inside the Alliance heartland, where outlying towns must rely on local volunteers rather than royal troops.
For humans across the southern provinces, this appeal reveals how strained rural settlements have become as the missing king and political neglect leave frontier lands vulnerable.
